name: Adline Chem Lab Ltd.
summary: Adline Chem Lab Ltd. is a pharmaceutical company dedicated to producing a variety of medicinal products. Their extensive product range includes multivitamins, anti-infective medications, items for pregnancy and reproductive health, hemostatic agents, and hepatocare treatments. Laskari Kamlesh Jagdish established the company on July 6, 1988, and its main office is located in Ahmedabad, India.
